solutions.name: Visor.ai AI agents (voice and chat)
solutions.what: AI agents that answer customer phone calls, built as flows on the platform, with test suites, live supervision and EU AI Act checks.

solutions.name: Chat AI Agent
solutions.what: AI agents on WhatsApp, websites and messaging channels that answer from a synced knowledge base and hand over to live chat.

solutions.name: Nexa
solutions.what: The platform's built-in agent that helps build, test and review agents, and proposes fixes that a person accepts.

solutions.name: Quality & Insights AI Agent
solutions.what: Scores call recordings against a customer's own scorecard and turns the scores into coaching and contact-reason reports.
